description: This Java class 'UtilIO' provides utility methods for input/output operations, including reading from streams and files, converting byte arrays to strings with consistent line endings, and writing strings to files or streams. It handles character encoding and line ending normalization.

classes.name: UtilIO
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for IO operations, including reading, writing, and line ending normalization.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies data from a Reader to an Appendable.

methods.name: readString
methods.description: Converts byte arrays, InputStreams, or Readers to a String with normalized line endings.

methods.name: writeString
methods.description: Writes a String to a File or OutputStream, converting line endings to platform-specific format.
